messages:
claire: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR that fixes a couple of mismatches in the /v1/generate API ref. Noticed two issues: the request example uses `prompt` (should be `input`) and one OpenAPI example still shows `maxTokens` instead of `max_new_tokens`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2555

riley: Thanks. Which files are affected so I can check the site build?

claire: docs/reference/generate.md, openapi/examples/generate.json, and snippets/js/generate.example.ts. Also updated the migration note under the top of the doc explaining the `prompt`->`input` normalization.

samir: Important: our SDK codegen expects the example payload to be an object, not an array. If any example shows `[{...}]` it'll generate bad TS/Go usage. I'll hold the SDK extraction job until the docs PR merges.

marta: Also saw a response example using `outputs` as a string in one place. Schema expects `choices: [{"text": ...}]`. Can you fix the response example too?

claire: Yup — changed response to `{ "id": "gen_01", "choices": [{ "text": "ok" }] }`. Left streaming examples alone. Kept all param names exactly (`max_new_tokens`, `temperature`).

riley: Small nit: the OpenAPI example JSON is copied into the docs site search index. After merge we should re-run the indexing job so search shows updated examples. Filing a follow-up infra job to re-index: infra#394.

docsbot: examples-lint: failed on openapi/examples/generate.json: line 12 - unexpected property `maxTokens`. See CI: https://ci.redwood/linters/11500

samir: I'll update the snippet extraction mapping after the docs commit is merged. Will reference the docs commit SHA in the SDK PR so snippets stay in sync.

claire: Pushed a small docs-only fix at 1748881300. PR includes: request example (prompt->input), response shape fix (choices array), OpenAPI example param rename, migration note. Ran `yarn docs:build` locally and checked the rendered page.

marta: Reviewing now. Checklist for merge: list files changed in PR, include migration note header "Note on request and param naming", confirm `max_new_tokens` unchanged, smoke test rendered page, and mention reindex job in PR description.

riley: LGTM on the smoke render. Confirmed openapi/examples/generate.json updated.

samir: I'm queued to create SDK PR once docs merge. Will not change streaming param names in that PR.

marta: Merged at 1748881398. Claire, please create a short ticket to track SDK snippet re-sync and search reindex so we don't miss downstream updates.

claire: Done — created follow-up issue #634. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :tada:
